app_tagline: Learn anything with an AI tutor.
storage_not_persistent_body: This browser context cannot keep data (a private window, or no support for local storage). Your sessions and key are lost when you close the page.
home_topic_label: What do you want to learn?
home_sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start one above.
home_need_key_title: Add your API key to start
home_need_key_body: kd-learn runs on your own model key. The key stays on this device.
settings_endpoint_gone: The server no longer offers this endpoint. Choose another one.
settings_endpoints_failed: Could not load the endpoint list from the server.
settings_model_description: The model name exactly as the provider spells it.
settings_key_description: Stored only in this browser. It is sent to the server with each turn so the server can call the provider, and the server does not keep it.
settings_key_saved_hint: A key is saved on this device. Leave this empty to keep it.
settings_missing: Enter a model and a key.
learn_not_found: This session does not exist on this device.
learn_broken: The saved log of this session is damaged: {reason}
plan_phase_probing: Getting to know what you already know
turn_interrupted_body: Your answer is saved. Send it again to continue.
turn_elsewhere: This turn is running in another tab.
error_Network: The connection was lost before the turn ended. Your answer is saved.
error_NoKey: Add a model and an API key in settings first.
error_Busy: Another tab is running this turn.
error_InvalidLog: The saved lesson does not accept this change.
error_HistoryTooLarge: This session has grown too long to send to the model. Start a new session to keep learning this topic.
error_UnknownEndpoint: The endpoint you chose is no longer available. Choose another one in settings.
error_provider_rejected: The provider rejected the request. Check the key and the model in settings.
skip_hint: You have spent a while on this step. You can move on.
done_body: You went through every step of this topic.
side_hint: Quick questions here stay out of the main lesson.
